name: Ruins of Aboraz
summary: Zanzil the Outcast and his mind-addled thralls now hold the old Gurubashi terraces on Stranglethorn Vale's southeastern cliffs.

sections.title: A Witch Doctor's Domain
sections.body: At Aboraz, weathered stone crowns the bluffs southeast of the Ruins of Jubuwal and south of the Crystalvein Mine. Zanzil the Outcast, an exiled witch doctor, has turned the courtyards into a place for alchemy. Banished by local tribes and mainlanders alike, he fled here to brew potions that alter the mind and toxic elixirs. His servants are shambling undead ghouls, corrupted troll thralls, and coastal naga under his control.

sections.title: Pawns and Captives
sections.body: Yenniku wanders the terraces, his mind still held by Zanzil's sorcery. Chucky 'Ten Thumbs' wanders there too. A pirate debtor fleeing the collection efforts of Booty Bay's 'Sea Wolf' MacKinley, Chucky has drunk Zanzil's draughts and now guards the compound, unaware of his plight.

faq.q: Who rules over the Ruins of Aboraz?
aliases: who is in ruins of aboraz
faq.answer: Zanzil the Outcast rules the ruins. The exiled witch doctor is known across Stranglethorn Vale for dark alchemy and powerful brews that control minds.

faq.q: Why are there naga and ghouls together here?
faq.answer: Zanzil has bound troll outcasts, raised jungle ghouls, and ensnared coastal naga to guard his terraces. His mixtures let him dominate minds and animate corpses.

faq.q: Where are the Ruins of Aboraz located?
aliases: how to get to ruins of aboraz
faq.answer: The Ruins of Aboraz stand on high bluffs in southeastern Stranglethorn Vale, south of the Crystalvein Mine and just southeast of the Ruins of Jubuwal. They overlook the eastern sea.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, Aboraz is an affront. An outcast uses perverted voodoo to enslave fellow trolls and hold young Yenniku in the ancestral lands of the Gurubashi.
Alliance privateers and mercenaries often cross paths with Zanzil's affairs while pursuing debts or bounties tied to Booty Bay's goblins and pirates.
